I don't think this is valid GLSL. You have two if statements in a row that don't do anything. Shader compilers differ between devices and driver versions. Most shader compilers will do their best to take invalid GLSL and produce something that runs, but many shader compilers will stick to the specification and give you nothing if your code isn't functional. My guess is you are running on a device that has a very lenient shader compiler and is basically ignoring the errors in your shader, while other devices are stricter and are failing because of this error
